title: HPE security advisory (AV26-909)
description: As of September 9, 2026, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) is affected by vulnerabilities in the following products:
products:
ClearPass Policy Manager (CPPM)
	Prior to or equal to 6.11.14
Prior to or equal to 6.12.8

HPE IceWall products
	Multiple versions and models
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
